annotations.title: Open a new alert in Poacher

description: Make a link that opens Poacher’s alert builder with a search already filled in. Give the link to the person: they sign in (or sign up), check the source and approve the price in Poacher. Use this when the person wants to finish in the app, or when this connection lacks monitoring:manage. With monitoring:manage, you can create and start the alert yourself instead (see the server instructions). The link saves and charges nothing until the person finishes in the app.

brief.description: What the person wants, in their words: item, condition, price ceiling, place. Poacher uses this to judge matches.

source_url.description: The public search or listing page to watch, for example an eBay or AbeBooks search results URL.
